answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a mirror as the anchor of the cost.
